result.rationale: The diff's addGuests.handler.ts dedupes with strict equality: `!booking.attendees.some((attendee) => guest === attendee.email)`. Email addresses are case-insensitive per RFC, and Prisma email storage may preserve case, so 'User@X.com' would pass the dedupe against stored 'user@x.com' and create a duplicate attendee row via createMany, plus send duplicate calendar/email invites. The mechanism is verifiable in the diff; the exact case-mismatch scenario is an edge case, so moderate confidence.

adjudication.rationale: In `addGuests.handler.ts`, deduplication uses a case-sensitive comparison: `!booking.attendees.some((attendee) => guest === attendee.email)` while `guest` is taken directly from input and not normalized (and the blacklist is normalized to lowercase but `guest` is not). This allows `User@x.com` to bypass the check when an existing attendee is `user@x.com`, leading to creation of a duplicate attendee row for the same mailbox via `createMany`.
